headline: HuyenBao v11.55 — PinZone redesign: prominent warnings + 2-row layout + readable charts
summary: DASHBOARD REDESIGN. The main PinZone dashboard was cramped (13 elements on one flex-wrap row), warnings were buried at the bottom, and chart labels were too small to read. Now: (1) Warning banner at the TOP — each warning is a clickable chip (critical=red / warn=orange / info=muted) that navigates to the relevant tab. New warnings added: lowCash, highLoan, sleepDebtHigh. (2) Identity row (avatar+name+age+stage+date) separated from stats row (cash+health+spirit+level+NW+income) — clean 2-row layout. (3) Health pill color-coded by state (red/orange/yellow/green). (4) Bigger chips (hpill-big, pchip-big classes). (5) Donut chart: thicker ring (12 vs 10), bigger center text (14 vs 11). (6) Bar chart: bigger bars (16 vs 14), bigger labels (9 vs 8), wider label column. (7) Chart legend font .72rem (was .66rem). Mobile: warning chips stack full-width, stats wrap 3-per-row.
features: NEW: Warning banner at the TOP of PinZone (was a single line at the bottom, easy to miss)
NEW: Each warning is a clickable chip → navigates to the relevant tab (health/bank/home/finance-overview)
NEW: 3 severity levels — critical (red 🔴) / warn (orange 🟠) / info (muted ℹ️)
NEW: 2 new warning types — att.lowCash (cash <$1K) + att.highLoan (loan >30% of NW)
NEW: sleepDebtHigh warning (debt >21h) as critical severity
RESTRUCTURE: agehead split into 2 rows — identity-row (avatar+name+age+stage+date) + stats-row (cash+health+spirit+level+NW+income)
NEW: Health pill color-coded by state — red (<20) / orange (<40) / yellow (<60) / green (60+)
NEW: hpill-big + pchip-big CSS classes — bigger stats chips (.88rem vs .78rem)
ENHANCE: DonutChart thicker ring (strokeWidth 12 vs 10) + bigger center text (14 vs 11)
ENHANCE: BarChart bigger bars (16px vs 14px) + bigger labels (9 vs 8) + wider label column (70 vs 60)
ENHANCE: Chart legend font .72rem (was .66rem) for readability
NEW: pinzone-v55 CSS class with its own padding + mobile rules
Mobile: warning chips stack full-width, stats wrap 3-per-row, identity date wraps to next line
NEW: i18n keys att.lowCash + att.highLoan (EN/VI/中文)
